excluded.freeipa: FreeIPA has a server and the clients that enrol with it, two kinds of host. Its README shows how to set them up.
excluded.k3s: k3s has servers and agents, two kinds of host. Its README shows how to set them up.
excluded.kubeadm: kubeadm has control planes and workers, two kinds of host. Its README shows how to set them up.
excluded.microshift: MicroShift turns the whole box into an OpenShift node, with its router on 80 and 443. Give it a host of its own and follow its README.
excluded.proxmox: Proxmox turns a Debian host into a hypervisor. Give it a machine of its own and follow its README.
excluded.velociraptor: Velociraptor has a server and the clients that report to it, two kinds of host. Its README shows how to set them up.
excluded.zabbix: Zabbix has a server and the agents that report to it, two kinds of host. Its README shows how to set them up.

conflicts.reason: both are a MySQL server on port 3306, and their packages replace each other
circuit-firewall has no rule for VRRP, so every host would claim the floating address

hints.apache: Name a virtual host and give it a folder to serve or an app to proxy to.
hints.certbot: Its standalone method needs port 80 free. With a web server on the host, set method to webroot or nginx.
hints.cockpit: Logs in with the server's own passwords, so the firewall keeps 9090 to your own network.
hints.couchdb: Listens on 127.0.0.1:5984, for a proxy such as Caddy in front.
hints.firewall: Keeps SSH open, then opens the ports your other picks listen on. The README it writes lists each one.
hints.forgejo: Keeps its data in SQLite and listens on 127.0.0.1:3000, for a proxy such as Caddy in front. Its README shows PostgreSQL.
hints.github-runner: Needs a registration token from the repository's runner settings. You set it as a secret when you run it, and the README says where to get one.
hints.gitlab: Wants a host with 8 GB of memory, and keeps ports 80, 443, 8080, 9090 and 9100 for itself.
hints.gitlab-runner: The runner token comes from GitLab's runner settings. The docker executor needs docker on the host too.
hints.grafana: Listens on 127.0.0.1:3000 unless you set http_addr.
hints.haproxy: Doesn't open the ports your frontends use. Add them to the firewall yourself.
hints.infisical: Brings PostgreSQL and Valkey along and points Infisical at them. Use letters and digits for both passwords, since they go into URLs. Listens on 127.0.0.1:8080, for a proxy in front.
hints.jenkins: Listens on 127.0.0.1:8080, for a proxy such as Caddy in front.
hints.keepalived: Give it two or more hosts on the same network.
hints.keycloak: Listens on 127.0.0.1:8080 and keeps its data in a file meant for trials. Its README shows PostgreSQL.
hints.langfuse: Brings PostgreSQL and Valkey along and points Langfuse at them. Runs ClickHouse and MinIO beside it on ports 8123, 9000 and 9002, and wants about 4 GB of memory. Listens on 127.0.0.1:3000.
hints.litellm: Brings PostgreSQL along and points LiteLLM at it. Use letters and digits for the password, since it goes into a URL. Add your models and API keys in main.tf afterwards; the README shows how.
hints.lldap: Listens on 127.0.0.1 only, for a proxy in front.
hints.matrix: Listens on 127.0.0.1:8008 for a proxy in front. server_name can never change once Synapse has started.
hints.monitoring: Runs on Docker, so circuit-docker comes with it. On Rocky Linux, Cockpit can hold port 9090.
hints.mssql: x86-64 only. Read Microsoft's licence terms before you tick accept_eula. The sa password is a secret you set when you run it.
hints.n8n: Listens on 127.0.0.1:5678 for a proxy in front. Set public_url, or its webhook links point at localhost.
hints.netdata: The dashboard listens on 127.0.0.1:19999. Open an SSH tunnel to see it.
hints.openldap: Listens on 127.0.0.1:389 only. Set ldap_address to serve other hosts.
hints.openwebui: Listens on 127.0.0.1:8080 and talks to Ollama on the same host, so pick ollama too, or set openai_base_url.
hints.otelcol: Doesn't open 4317 or 4318. For a gateway, add them to the firewall yourself.
hints.php: Runs PHP-FPM on a Unix socket. Pick nginx or Apache too, and point it at the socket as the README shows.
hints.presidio: Answers on 127.0.0.1:5001 and 5002, for apps on the same host.
hints.prometheus: On Rocky Linux, Cockpit can hold port 9090, and Prometheus won't start beside it.
hints.wireguard: Give it two or more hosts. Each one peers with the others.
hints.zeek: Set interface to the network card Zeek should watch.
